env.buildCommand:
workspace=/nix/store/v60m8all4g09cj98vjhwf1c5cmjxy1pk-source/.dev-workspace.json
catalog=/nix/store/f5h1qmr03qva6khyijgc2wxd1ff4k4cw-dev-workspace-0.2.0/share/dev-workspace/extensions.json
expected=$(/nix/store/wm4pfgq6l2wgc2cqfvfidl5y3mc9r2xx-jq-1.8.2-bin/bin/jq -c \
  '.developmentClusterProviders | sort' "$workspace")
actual=$(/nix/store/wm4pfgq6l2wgc2cqfvfidl5y3mc9r2xx-jq-1.8.2-bin/bin/jq -c \
  '[.clusterProviders[].id] | sort' "$catalog")
test "$expected" = "$actual"
for provider in $(/nix/store/wm4pfgq6l2wgc2cqfvfidl5y3mc9r2xx-jq-1.8.2-bin/bin/jq -r \
  '.developmentClusterProviders[]' "$workspace"); do
  command=$(/nix/store/wm4pfgq6l2wgc2cqfvfidl5y3mc9r2xx-jq-1.8.2-bin/bin/jq -er \
    --arg provider "$provider" \
    '.clusterProviders[] | select(.id == $provider) | .command' \
    "$catalog")
  test -x "$command"
  test -x /nix/store/f5h1qmr03qva6khyijgc2wxd1ff4k4cw-dev-workspace-0.2.0/libexec/workspace-portal/"$provider"-devcluster
done
touch "$out"
env.name: workspace-cluster-provider-composition-tests
